recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7044 unless Patient Care creates a new decision that explicitly supersedes the later category decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-7044 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care issue for the DSTU1 AllergyIntolerance category value set. It asked whether the category list was sufficient for substances such as latex and resolved to add an other category code.
initial_application: The request was applied in git-svn commit a30496dcda9c86251cf286f1636c23e570a80113, whose subject lists #7044 and says code Other was added to the category. Release2 generated valueset history also shows allergy-intolerance-category containing food, medication, environment, and other.
additional_context: The current build includes AllergyIntolerance as an active resource. Current source defines AllergyIntolerance.category as 0..* code with a required binding to ValueSet/allergy-intolerance-category, and the complete current code system contains food, medication, environment, and biologic only. Later Patient Care issues FHIR-10262 and FHIR-10760 revisited latex/rubber/animal-hair and substance/other coverage, rejected substance/other additions, added biologic, and broadened environment to include any substance not already classified as food, medication, or biologic. Later No Change decisions FHIR-20049 and FHIR-45243 did not reopen the list in favor of other.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Re-adding other would conflict with later final decisions and with the current environment definition adopted to cover non-food, non-medication, non-biologic substances.

related_jiras.note: Revisited substance-style category coverage, declined a substance code, added biologic, and noted removal of the earlier other code.
Clarified the biologic definition that remains in the current category code system.
Directly proposed substance and other but resolved to broaden environment instead.
Later US Core request to retain/add other was resolved No Change with Patient Care noting category is optional.
Later core request to loosen the category binding was resolved No Change after examples were mapped to the existing four categories.
Category datatype/binding audit is already represented on the combined branch and is consistent with the current required code value set.
